plainText:
Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd & Pichu (Japanese: ポケモンテイルズ「ネギガナイトとピチューの 」 Pokémon Tales: The Adventures of & Pichu) is a series created as a collaboration between British studio and The Pokémon Company International. It has been described as a "special project" scheduled to be released in 2027.

==History==
 
The collaboration was announced on December 11, 2024 with a teaser short released alongside the announcement. On July 22, 2025, a sneak peek trailer announcing the project's title was shown via Pokémon Presents.
